# Write the plant spec

## Job

Write the spec for water_sedge, a real wild ground plant or shrub
growing in Work region (Scaffolding), spec id `water_sedge`.
Blender builds it into the low-poly game model from your spec, so
sculpt with overlapping simple solids: every number below is in
metres. Simple, not realistic: the right shape, rough size, main
colours and the one or two telling marks are enough.

## Input

What grows there (the survey's own words about this place's plants):

```
- water_sedge grows here
```

Two finished specs to follow for shape: a bush first, then a
ground plant. Follow the closer one; a small plant keeps its
leaves near the ground, never stacked up a stalk:

```
A bush (bilberry):

  "name": "Bilberry",

  "author": "Animundo team",
  "kind": "bush",
  "year": {
    "leaves": "deciduous",
    "flowers": "Small pinkish bells under the leaves, mid May to mid June. One of the bumblebee's first big foods of the year.",
    "fruit": "Blue-black berries ripen from mid-July into September.",
    "notes": "Leaves turn red in autumn and fall. The angular stems stay green all winter, under the snow. Grows as a carpet in shady spruce and pine forest."
  },

    "berry": "#36437a"
  },

    "autumn": {"leaf": "#c4493a", "leaf_dark": "#a53c36"}
